_description: Builds a coached adoption description by combining raw text, foster notes, and gap context from /bcs/score to target the exact dimensions that scored zero.

request.raw_text: Moose is a 3 year old lab mix. He is good with other dogs and kids. He is house trained. He has been in foster care for 4 months.
request.foster_notes: Been with us 4 months. Loves fetch. Great with our kids.

personality_hook.gap: No specific moment or memorable detail. Could describe any lab.

foster_voice.gap: Reads like a form. No warmth, no relationship visible.

family_vision.gap: Nothing forms. Can't picture this dog anywhere.

response.coached_description:
Moose has a move. The second you sit on the floor — doesn't matter why — he finds the nearest tennis ball and drops it in your lap. Not asking. Just assuming you came to play. He's been doing it since day one, to every single person who walked through the door.

He's three, fully house-trained, great with other dogs and kids. He's been patient in a way that shouldn't be possible — four months in rescue, and every day he keeps showing up.

He needs a family who'll actually let him tire them out. He will find the tennis ball. He will drop it in your lap. The only question is whether you're ready for that.

coaching_packet.what_changed: Pulled the fetch behavior from foster notes and made it the personality hook. Rewrote in first-person foster voice. Closed with the family vision — the adopter can picture this dog in their living room.
